evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-13"} returned 201 and {"dueDate":"2026-10-13"}. POST without a dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD value with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-01-01"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate null. PATCH /todos/3 with {"dueDate":"2026-12-12"} changed the date to 2026-12-12.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "14.10.2026" and "2026-10-14T10:00:00Z" each returned 400 with {"error":"dueDate must be a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format"}. PATCH with "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today in UTC is 2026-10-14. I created todos due yesterday, today and in the future, one with no due date, and one overdue todo that I then marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-13. Today's todo, the future todo, the todo without a date and the done todo were all excluded. GET /todos without the parameter returned all five.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed "(fällig 2026-10-13)", "(fällig 2026-10-14)", "(fällig 2026-12-12)" and "(fällig 2026-01-01)" next to the matching todos. The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the todo "past" (due 2026-10-13) had the text "überfällig". The todos due today, due in the future, without a date, and the done todo with a past date had no such marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only "past" with its "überfällig" marker. The other four todos disappeared.
